evidence.text: Implemented vati_tax.exports (rules/service/store/api) + Vati Evidence Export DocType: scoped export request naming case evidence, approval by a different supervisor (export.approve, separation of duties), frozen manifest with document SHA-256, lineage, extraction revision and per-record retention metadata (pilot-synthetic-unverified-1, no disposal; audit ledger permanent); every step, read and refusal sealed into the TAX-059 ledger. Observed 2026-11-04: 27 Frappe-free tests pass in exports/test_service.py; full backend suite 269 tests OK (37 site-backed skipped); repo-wide mypy and ruff clean. ADR-016.

Observed 2026-11-04 (.venv-dev, python -m unittest vati_tax.exports.test_service): other-case, other-tenant, unknown and source-leaked evidence refused as not_found and recorded as export.request.denied; taxpayer/service refused; manifest entries carry each document_sha256, lineage and extraction provenance (matches_document) and manifest_sha256 detects tampering; only requester/approver read it. Mutation check: removing separation of duties, the tenant filter or the reader check each fails the suite. LIMITATION: site-backed exports/test_exports_bench.py written but NOT run - Docker Desktop does not start on this machine; run scripts/frappe_dev.py verify before relying on the Frappe binding.

Observed: PR #144 opened with tests/evidence/limitations, CI all green (validate, quality, ai-smoke, auditor-browser, frontend-browser) and merged 2026-11-04T12:36:03Z.
